Bash(python -c "
from src.database import engine
from sqlmodel import SQLModel
from sqlalchemy import inspect, text

# Check for foreign key constraints properly
with engine.connect\(\) as conn:
    result = conn.execute\(text\(''''''
    SELECT tc.constraint_name, tc.table_name, kcu.column_name, 
           ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name,
           ccu.column_name AS foreign_column_name
    FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc
    JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu
      ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
      AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
    JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu
      ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
      AND ccu.table_schema = tc.table_schema
    WHERE tc.constraint_type = ''FOREIGN KEY'' AND ccu.table_name = ''users'';
    ''''''\)\)
    fks = result.fetchall\(\)
    print\(''Foreign key constraints to users table:'', len\(fks\)\)
    
    for fk in fks:
        print\(f''  {fk[0]}: {fk[1]}.{fk[2]} -> {fk[3]}.{fk[4]}''\)

# Now drop and recreate tables according to the models
from src.models.user import User
from src.models.task import Task

# Drop all existing tables \(drop child tables first\)
with engine.connect\(\) as conn:
    trans = conn.begin\(\)
    try:
        # Drop tasks table first \(due to foreign key dependency\)
        conn.execute\(text\(''DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tasks CASCADE;''\)\)
        print\(''Dropped tasks table''\)
        
        # Then drop users table
        conn.execute\(text\(''DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;''\)\)
        print\(''Dropped users table''\)
        
        # Also drop the old User and Todo tables if they exist
        conn.execute\(text\(''DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ""User"" CASCADE;''\)\)
        print\(''Dropped User table''\)
        conn.execute\(text\(''DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Todo CASCADE;''\)\)
        print\(''Dropped Todo table''\)
        
        # Drop the Prisma migrations table if it exists
        conn.execute\(text\(''DROP TABLE IF EXISTS _prisma_migrations CASCADE;''\)\)
        print\(''Dropped _prisma_migrations table''\)
        
        trans.commit\(\)
        print\(''All old tables dropped successfully''\)
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f''Error dropping tables: {e}''\)
        trans.rollback\(\)

print\(''Recreating tables...''\)
SQLModel.metadata.create_all\(engine\)
print\(''Tables recreated successfully''\)

# Verify the new structure
with engine.connect\(\) as conn:
    result = conn.execute\(text\(''''''
    SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable
    FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_name = ''users'' 
    ORDER BY ordinal_position;
    ''''''\)\)
    columns = result.fetchall\(\)
    print\(''New Users table columns:''\)
    for col in columns:
        print\(f''  {col[0]}: {col[1]}, nullable: {col[2]}''\)
")
